paper.title_en: Moving Beyond Quasinormal Modes and Reinterpreting Direct Waves in Binary Black Hole Merger-Ringdowns
paper.abstract_en: Based on black-hole perturbation-theory calculations and an effective-one-body picture of binary black hole mergers, it has been suggested that a direct wave may be present and measurable in the ringdown. Furthermore, it has been suggested that this signal might originate from substantially inside the light ring (or photon sphere) of the remnant black hole, perhaps even from close to the event horizon. In this paper, we present three independent strands of evidence against such claims. In the process, we show that there is indeed an early-time part of the ringdown signal that cannot be directly modeled by quasinormal modes. However, there is no evidence that this is a direct wave as it has previously been defined, and we show that the properties of this component are related to the remnant's light ring rather than its horizon.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接处理铃宕建模与早期信号是否属于直接波的可检验问题，对黑洞微扰论与广义相对论基础议题有实质理论深度，摘要给出明确的反驳论点与机制解释，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 超越准正规模式并重新解释双黑洞并合-铃宕中的直接波
decision.abstract_zh: 基于黑洞微扰论计算以及双黑洞并合的有效单体图像，此前有人提出，在铃宕中可能存在一种直接波并且可以被测量到。此外，还有人提出，这一信号可能起源于残余黑洞光球（光子球）内部相当深的位置，甚至可能来自接近事件视界之处。在本论文中，我们提出三条相互独立的证据来反驳这类主张。在此过程中，我们表明铃宕信号中确实存在一个早期部分，无法直接由准正规模式建模。然而，没有证据表明这就是此前所定义的那种直接波，并且我们表明该成分的性质与残余黑洞的光环而非其视界相关。
